crossRefs.note: Do good to your servant, according to your word, Yahweh.
Deal with your servant according to your loving kindness. Teach me your statutes.
Turn to me, and have mercy on me, as you always do to those who love your name.
I will sing to Yahweh, because he has been good to me.
Return to your rest, my soul, for Yahweh has dealt bountifully with you.
From his fullness we all received grace upon grace.
Let each man give according as he has determined in his heart, not grudgingly or under compulsion, for God loves a…
My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.
For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus made me free from the law of sin and of death.
But God, being rich in mercy, for his great love with which he loved us,
even when we were dead through our trespasses, made us alive together with Christ—by grace you have been saved—
For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in…
For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all men,
instructing us to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we would live soberly, righteously, and godly…
If you know that he is righteous, you know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of him.
For this is loving God, that we keep his commandments. His commandments are not grievous.
For whatever is born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world: your faith.

translations.web: Do good to your servant. I will live and I will obey your word.
translations.bsb: Deal bountifully with Your servant, that I may live and keep Your word.
translations.kjv: GIMEL. Deal bountifully with thy servant, that I may live, and keep thy word.
translations.asv: GIMEL. Deal bountifully with thy servant, that I may live; So will I observe thy word.
